abstract: Testicular cancer comprises different neoplasms, depending on the cell of origin and the typical age at presentation, but germ cell-derived tumors constitute the vast majority of cases. Testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT) can be diagnosed in every age group, but more than 90% of cases occur in young men. These tumors, comprising seminoma and nonseminoma, are derived from germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS). Pathogenesis of TGCT associated with GCNIS partly overlaps with that of other developmental disorders of the male reproductive system within the testicular dysgenesis syndrome (TDS). Testicular somatic cell neoplasms, known as sex cord-stromal tumors, are relatively rare, but can have endocrine manifestations, such as precocious puberty or gynecomastia. In addition to its malignant features, cancer of the testis represents a developmental, endocrine, and reproductive problem. These issues are the focus of this chapter, and emphasis is given to aspects that are of interest to endocrinologists, including pediatric endocrinologists and andrologists. Management of invasive testicular tumors is largely handled by urologists and oncologists, thus only general information on surgical treatment, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy is presented. Impact of cancer treatment on the endocrine system, co-morbidities, fertility issues, and quality of life issues are also briefly reviewed. For complete coverage of all related areas of Endocrinology, please visit our on-line FREE web-text, WWW.ENDOTEXT.ORG.
abstract_ja: 精巣がんは細胞起源と診断時の典型的な年齢によって異なる腫瘍から構成されるが、大部分は胚細胞由来腫瘍である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）はあらゆる年齢層で診断され得るが、90%以上は若年男性に発生する。セミノーマと非セミノーマを含むこれらの腫瘍は、胚細胞上皮内腫瘍（GCNIS）に由来する。GCNISを伴うTGCTの病因は、精巣異形成症候群（TDS）に含まれる男性生殖器系の他の発生異常の病因と部分的に重なる。精巣の体細胞腫瘍である性索間質性腫瘍は比較的稀であるが、思春期早発症や女性化乳房などの内分泌症状を呈することがある。精巣がんは悪性腫瘍としての側面に加え、発生、内分泌、生殖に関わる問題でもある。本章ではこれらの問題を取り上げ、内分泌専門医（小児内分泌専門医および男性生殖医学の専門医を含む）にとって関心の高い側面を重点的に扱う。浸潤性精巣腫瘍の管理は主に泌尿器科医と腫瘍内科医が担うため、外科的治療、放射線療法、化学療法に関する一般的な情報のみを提示する。がん治療が内分泌系、合併症、妊孕性、生活の質に与える影響も簡潔に概説する。
